items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: it seemed like they were like Duke

ctx.x: What was different about their sound?

One thing about it is, it's a funny thing, but it seemed like that all of them had a big tone; they didn't have this little tone and you talk about soul, it seemed like they were like Duke. You might read it soul but you might be calling it swing, and Duke said, don't mean a thing if it ain't got that swing.
